items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Like I don't doubt that an Ella Fitzgerald or a Sarah Vaughan or a Lena Horne, somebody like that, you know, after they were a big name, then he'd hire them to sing with the band

ctx.x: Their function was a minor function.

The vocalist was just a part of what was going on, not to be a featured singer, not to be a star as such. If, after they came with the band, they became a star, that was something else. But he wasn't going around looking to hire any stars, you know. Like I don't doubt that an Ella Fitzgerald or a Sarah Vaughan or a Lena Horne, somebody like that, you know, after they were a big name, then he'd hire them to sing with the band, you know. Then everybody would say, 'Oh, wow, Lena Horne singing with Duke!' You know.…
Well, I think that's -- can you think of anything that we haven't covered? We've got Duke. After you left Duke you were ill. What was wrong with you then?
